titulo: The gaming site sponsored by Walmart lays off its editorial staff
cuerpo: Restart, a games media website launched in late 2024 that was sponsored by Walmart, has laid off its "entire editorial team," according to a Friday post from Brandy Berthelson, the site's former editor-in-chief.
